#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-moe-resident
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on off; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 18996 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18996/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 "$root/short-quality.py" http://127.0.0.1:18996 "$arm" "$root/short-quality-$arm.json" > "$root/short-quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18996 "resident-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18996 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done

import concurrent.futures
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

url, arm, output = sys.argv[1:]
model = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(url + '/v1/models'))['data'][0]['id']
cases = [
 ('addition', 'Compute 17 + 26. Reply with only the integer.\nAnswer:', '43'),
 ('multiplication', 'Compute 14 * 6. Reply with only the integer.\nAnswer:', '84'),
 ('subtraction', 'Compute 100 - 37. Reply with only the integer.\nAnswer:', '63'),
 ('division', 'Compute 144 / 12. Reply with only the integer.\nAnswer:', '12'),
 ('extraction', 'Mira lives in Oslo. Omar lives in Lima. In which city does Omar live? Reply with only the city.\nAnswer:', 'lima'),
 ('comparison', 'Ada has 9 coins, Ben has 14 coins, and Chen has 11 coins. Who has the most coins? Reply with only the name.\nAnswer:', 'ben'),
 ('sequence', 'Continue the sequence with one number: 3, 6, 9, 12,\nAnswer:', '15'),
 ('logic', 'All tulips are flowers. This plant is a tulip. Is this plant a flower? Reply yes or no.\nAnswer:', 'yes'),
 ('classification', 'Classify the sentiment as positive or negative: "The service was terrible and I regret going."\nAnswer:', 'negative'),
 ('translation', 'Translate the English word "cat" into Spanish. Reply with only one word.\nAnswer:', 'gato'),
 ('deduction', 'The red box is heavier than the blue box. The blue box is heavier than the green box. Which box is lightest? Reply with only its color.\nAnswer:', 'green'),
 ('instruction', 'Reply with exactly the word ORCHID and no other text.\nAnswer:', 'orchid'),
]
def run(case):
    name, prompt, expected = case
    body = dict(model=model, prompt=prompt, add_special_tokens=False, temperature=0, max_tokens=64)
    request = urllib.request.Request(url + '/v1/completions', data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        result = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=600))
        text = result['choices'][0]['text']
        words = re.findall(r'[a-z]+|[0-9]+', text.lower())
        passed = bool(words) and words[0] == expected
        return dict(name=name,prompt=prompt,expected=expected,text=text,passed=passed,usage=result.get('usage'),seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)
    except Exception as e:
        return dict(name=name,prompt=prompt,expected=expected,passed=False,error=str(e))
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20) as pool:
    records = list(pool.map(run, cases))
record = dict(arm=arm,concurrency=20,cells=records,passed=sum(c['passed'] for c in records),total=len(records),scope='Twelve short completion tasks; first answer token checked. Diagnostic smoke only, not broad model-quality equivalence.')
Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
